question: What is the money? (origin + character of each major deposit)
known: Nothing about the balance is documented in the repo.
missing: Origin/character per deposit: salary, property sale, inheritance, emigrant property, gift, dividend, prior FX conversion, existing FX.
answer: Route follows origin (see Methods). No route is verified for gift/undocumented money (M14).
discovery: Ask the bank for a written account/transaction classification; pull statements, contracts, tax vouchers per deposit.

question: How is the account classified: jingwai geren (foreign individual) or jingnei geren (domestic individual)?
known: Two SAFE instruments use different definitions; bank sets category from ID at opening (T18).
missing: Bank's written classification + ID used at opening.
answer: Determines which article (59 vs 64) and whether convenience amount applies.
discovery: Request the bank's written classification; confirm passport vs resident ID on file.

question: What exactly is the quoted 'considerable tax'? (name, basis, rate, base, office)
known: No official source reviewed imposes a standalone Chinese tax merely on converting CNY or wiring own principal.
missing: Tax name, legal basis, rate, base, assessing office, written quote.
answer: Bank document requests can look like a conversion tax but are compliance, not tax. Do not pay without the written breakdown.
discovery: Ask the bank to itemise in writing: tax vs fee vs FX spread vs document charge.

question: Has Chinese tax on the income been paid / withheld / exempted?
known: PRC IIT: 20% flat on dividends/property gains/rent/interest (T25). Salary already taxed has nothing further on remittance.
missing: Filing history, vouchers, exemption certificates per income type.
answer: Unpaid Chinese tax is pursued by the tax office (T16); late charges unknown - blank.
discovery: Obtain tax payment/exemption certificates; ask tax office for account transcript.

question: Are you a US citizen only, or also a Chinese citizen / green-card holder / former hukou holder?
known: US passport alone does not confer the USD 50,000 convenience amount (T05).
missing: Citizenship(s), green-card status, hukou history, residence days.
answer: Green-card holders get the convenience amount (T05); domestic individuals use Art. 64 (T07); emigrant route needs former hukou (T12).
discovery: Confirm ID documents and hukou/residence history in writing.

question: When and at what rate was the CNY acquired (for US currency gain)?
known: IRS yearly averages known (T26); actual acquisition dates/rates unknown.
missing: Acquisition date/rate per lot; bank withdrawal method (FIFO/LIFO/pro-rata).
answer: Gain = USD received minus USD basis of RMB sold. Personal gain <=USD 200 ignored; >USD 200 capital gain (T31). Investment/business money: ordinary under s.988 (see Tax page).
discovery: Reconstruct lots from statements; pick a reasonable consistent basis method.

question: What is your US tax residency / filing status / marginal rate?
known: Unknown.
missing: Residency, filing status, marginal rate, FTC eligibility.
answer: Determines tax on any s.988 gain and FTC for Chinese tax paid. No personal rate is assumed - tax blank.
discovery: Confirm with tax adviser; do not use a generic rate.

question: FBAR / Form 8938 / Form 3520 status?
known: FBAR threshold USD 10,000 aggregate (T33); Form 8938 US-resident single USD 50k/75k (T34).
missing: Past filings, aggregate max balances, account interest/signature authority.
answer: Willful FBAR max = greater of USD 165,353 or 50% of balance (T32) - dwarfs FX costs. Fix reporting before wiring.
discovery: Review prior FBAR/8938 filings; compute aggregate max per year.

question: What are the actual transaction quotes (sending bank, provider, intermediary, receiving bank)?
known: BOC tariff + board known (T01|T02); BofA inbound may be USD 15 (T30).
missing: Sending-bank rate/fees, provider fee/FX, intermediary deductions, receiving fee.
answer: Known BOC-side cost is an estimate, not a quote. Unknowns stay blank, never zero.
discovery: Get dated written quotes for the exact amount/date; confirm intermediary deductions.

question: Do you have the source documents the bank will require?
known: Art. 59 needs ID + source materials incl. tax vouchers (T04).
missing: Contracts, salary slips, tax vouchers, title docs, inheritance docs per route.
answer: Without documents the bank cannot process the documented route; do not invent a purpose.
discovery: List documents per route (Steps page); obtain certified copies.

question: Is any part already foreign currency (not CNY)?
known: Unknown.
missing: Currency breakdown of balance.
answer: If already FX, wire only (M03) - no conversion, no spread.
discovery: Confirm currency breakdown with bank.

question: Is any part unused CNY from your own prior FX exchange?
known: Unknown.
missing: Original exchange slip + date (24-month validity, T09).
answer: Reconversion route (M02) if within 24 months.
discovery: Locate original exchange slips.

question: Is the money home-sale proceeds?
known: Route exists with price-less-taxes cap (T15).
missing: Sale contract, title/registration docs, tax voucher.
answer: M04 applies; remit <= price less taxes.
discovery: Collect sale + tax documents.

question: Is it inheritance or emigrant property?
known: Approval route exists (T12|T13).
missing: Hukou/settlement/inheritance/tax documents; approval office.
answer: M05/M06 need SAFE approval first; bank remits to own account abroad.
discovery: Identify approval office (former/last hukou) and document list.

question: Is it dividend from your own Chinese company?
known: 20% statutory (T25); 10% treaty cap if beneficial owner (T27).
missing: Profit resolution, tax filing, beneficial-ownership/residence evidence.
answer: M09 vs M09T differ by USD 40,000 tax on USD 400,000 gross - eligibility is decisive.
discovery: Confirm treaty eligibility with adviser; do not assume 10%.

question: Do you meet Wise from-CNY eligibility?
known: Needs non-mainland status + China work + tax record in last 3 years; limit = salary less tax (T28).
missing: Tax records, work history, remaining limit.
answer: If eligible, M12 may apply; fee/FX blank until in-app quote.
discovery: Check limit in Wise app; upload tax records.

question: Do you need cash abroad, or bank-to-bank?
known: WU China: cash pickup only, bank delivery unavailable (T29).
missing: Delivery need; partner-bank access.
answer: M13 only fits cash pickup; fee/FX blank.
discovery: Confirm delivery method before using M13.

question: How much, and over what period? (quota/ATM/cash caps)
known: Caps: quota USD 50k/yr (T06); ATM CNY 10k/day, 100k/yr (T19); cash USD 5k/10k (T20).
missing: Amount + timeline + trip count.
answer: Caps determine units/years in Costs page; splitting via others is prohibited (T10|T22).
discovery: Map amount to caps before choosing route.

question: What is the receiving account (own name? US bank?)?
known: Emigrant/inheritance bank remits to own account abroad (T12).
missing: Receiving bank, account name, SWIFT/IBAN.
answer: Own-name receiving account required for approval routes; BofA inbound may be USD 15 (T30).
discovery: Confirm own-name receiving details + fee schedule.

question: What must NOT be used?
known: Private swaps/underground banks unlawful (T21); crypto exchange banned (T23); splitting pattern fined (T22).
answer: Relatives' quotas, false invoices/purposes, crypto conversion, borrowed cards, excess cash.
discovery: Do not use; see Penalties page ceilings.

question: What is the FX rate on the day of execution?
known: Board 2026/11/11 20:50:05 known (T01); execution rate will differ.
missing: Dated execution quote.
answer: Costs are dated estimates; re-price on execution day.
discovery: Get same-day board + bank quote.

question: Are there intermediary-bank deductions?
known: Unknown; not in BOC tariff.
missing: Intermediary chain + deductions.
answer: Excluded from known cost; ask bank to confirm.
discovery: Ask sending bank about intermediary deductions.

question: What Chinese late-payment / surcharge exposure exists if tax is unpaid?
known: Unpaid tax pursued (T16); surcharge rate/look-back not verified in this session.
missing: Tax arrears, surcharge rate, look-back period.
answer: Blank - do not estimate. See Flagged F03.
discovery: Ask tax office for arrears + surcharge calculation in writing.

question: Does the USD 50,000 figure cap your balance?
known: No - it is a convenience amount, not a cap/tax (T06).
answer: Above USD 50,000 use documented route (M01), not splitting.
discovery: Do not split through others (T10).

question: Can you wire CNY offshore and convert there (M08)?
known: Cross-border RMB settlement supported in principle (T24).
missing: Bank offer, offshore account, both price components.
answer: Price blank - no published fee/FX in this session.
discovery: Ask bank for written cross-border RMB offer + offshore conversion quote.

question: What is the cheapest lawful route for your origin?
known: See Methods ranking; BOC-side cost modest vs tax/reporting exposure.
missing: Origin (Q01) + eligibility (Q05/Q15/Q16).
answer: Match origin to route; cheapest = documented route for that origin.
discovery: Use the 4-question test on Summary page.

question: What records must you keep for US reporting?
known: Gain basis, FBAR max balances, 8938 values.
missing: Statements, exchange slips, tax vouchers, wire confirmations.
answer: Keep per-lot basis + max-balance records; file FBAR/8938 as required.
discovery: Create a per-deposit file before wiring.

question: What is unverified and must stay blank?
known: Wise/WU fees, cross-border RMB price, surcharge rate, personal US tax rate.
missing: Dated provider/bank quotes; adviser determination.
answer: Blank + flagged (Flagged page); never zero.
discovery: Obtain quotes; do not infer.
